--- 2026-09-13: Two long-deferred Phase 1 decisions resolved by the user (via AskUserQuestion, PM presented tradeoffs rather than picking silently) ---

DECIDED: Real OmniVoice GPU voice-cloning integration will NOT be pursued. The actual k2-fsa/OmniVoice API is zero-shot voice cloning requiring a reference audio sample, not the natural-language 'voice design' the original ROADMAP envisioned -- and raises consent/rights questions the project can't resolve on its own. Edge TTS (already working, 10 accents x 3 genders, live-verified) is now the SOLE official TTS engine. Implemented: SpeakerConfig.tts_engine now defaults to edge_tts, Step 4's per-speaker engine picker (a dead choice) removed. OmniVoice's semaphore/fallback code stays in place as an honest, still-tested branch -- just no longer a build target.

DECIDED: LivePortrait avatar images will be user-uploaded (matches the original ROADMAP design -- never app-generated likenesses). Sub-task 1.7c delivered: app/services/avatar_service.py (magic-byte-checked PNG/JPEG upload, 8MB cap, one file per speaker), POST/GET/DELETE /api/projects/{id}/speakers/{id}/avatar, /step5 upload/preview/remove UI. Real LivePortrait lip-sync model integration itself remains a separate, NOT-YET-STARTED future effort -- this only unblocked the avatar-sourcing question, not the inference pipeline.
--- Phase 2 progress (2026-09-13 onward) ---

Task 2.3 UX Polish CLOSED (all 7 ROADMAP items resolved): (1)+(2) step progress indicator + breadcrumb nav (StepNav.render(), all 7 step pages, by Codex). (3) Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter triggers each page's primary button when visible+enabled (KeyboardShortcuts.init()); Esc-to-cancel already covered by native confirm() dialogs + existing inline-edit revert handlers, no code needed there. (4) Empty states: audited, already satisfied everywhere it matters, no code needed. (5) Error toasts: Dashboard had 2 real gaps (misleading empty-state on load failure, raw alert() on delete failure) -- fixed with the same #error-banner pattern used everywhere else; music_library.js already had an equivalent system under different element ids. (6) Auto-save indicator: new shared save_indicator.js mounted in the header of /step2, /step3, /step6 (the 3 pages with a real page-level autosave concept), purely additive alongside each page's existing inline indicator -- /step4 (per-field autosave, no single document) and pages with no autosave concept intentionally excluded. (7) Responsive layout: audited at 1024px, zero horizontal overflow anywhere already (thanks to repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...)) grids + one existing @media rule) -- closed via a new permanent 9-page regression suite, no code change needed.

Task 2.2 Bug Fixes & Performance done for its buildable scope: fixed 4 real event-loop-blocking calls (video_service.generate_video, tts_service.synthesize_line -- a per-line hot path, audio_service.mix_project, app/api/tts.py's list_engines) by wrapping them in asyncio.to_thread; zero behavior change (55 pre-existing tests pass unmodified). 'Fix Gemini retry logic for 429' was already done since Phase 1 -- closed via audit. 'Optimize OmniVoice batch' is moot post-decision. 'Add progress cancellation (stop mid-generation)' explicitly LEFT OPEN, not closed -- every generation route is a synchronous request/response call with no background-job/cancellation mechanism anywhere; building real cancellation needs an architectural change, correctly recognized as too large for this slice.

Test suite at end of this entry: 493 tests passing (0 failures on a clean run; a documented, tracked Gemini-retry-pattern timing flake occasionally trips exactly one test during an unusually slow full-suite run -- always passes in isolation, tracked in .viepilot/debug/session-debug-20260912T000000Z.json, closed wontfix). Latest commit: 98ba6b8, pushed, working tree clean.
